title: Discovery Engine v1alpha: Major Breaking Changes & API Expansion
summary: This update introduces significant breaking changes to the Discovery Engine v1alpha API, making numerous parameters strictly required and many properties immutable. Concurrently, the API surface has undergone a massive expansion, particularly impacting the re-rolled out NotebookLM features.
details:
Developers integrating with Discovery Engine v1alpha must update their clients immediately. Many API parameters, including `billingAccountLicenseConfig`, `name`, `parent`, `project`, `location`, `resource`, `collectionsId`, `locationsId`, `projectsId`, `dataStore`, `completionConfig`, `servingConfig`, `siteSearchEngine`, `analytics`, `evaluation`, `groundingConfig`, `identityMappingStore`, and `rankingConfig`, are now strictly required. This will break existing calls that do not provide them. Additionally, a large number of properties across various schemas (e.g., `isActionConfigured` in `GoogleCloudDiscoveryengineV1ActionConfig`, `createTime` and `updateTime` in many resources, and numerous fields in `GoogleCloudNotebooklmV1alpha*` schemas) have been marked as read-only or immutable. This means any attempts to write to these fields will now fail.

This change aligns with the recent re-rollout of the NotebookLM alpha API surface, which was previously removed and is now being reinstated with stricter controls. Beyond these breaking changes, the API has seen a substantial expansion with new resources and methods across `collections`, `datastores`, `engines`, `evaluations`, `identityMappingStores`, `licenseConfigs`, `notebooks`, `rankingConfigs`, `sampleQuerySets`, and `userStores`, alongside new OAuth scopes for `assist.readwrite`, `readwrite`, and `serving.readwrite` capabilities.
